description: This header file declares utility functions for WebRTC session description parsing, ICE candidate parsing, error message parsing, and ICE server message handling in the context of a WebRTC streaming application. It defines functions that convert JSON messages into WebRTC interface objects and vice versa.

methods.name: ParseSessionDescription
methods.description: Parses a WebRTC session description (SDP) from a JSON message into a SessionDescriptionInterface object.

methods.name: ParseIceCandidate
methods.description: Parses an ICE candidate from a JSON message into an IceCandidateInterface object.

methods.name: ParseError
methods.description: Parses an error message from a JSON message into a string.

methods.name: ParseIceServersMessage
methods.description: Extracts ICE server configurations from a JSON message into a vector of ICE server objects.

methods.name: GenerateIceServersMessage
methods.description: Creates a JSON message representing a list of ICE servers.
